title: s06 m2 (speakeasy, v10 x12 picture, 663 frames = 22.100 s): music treatment per conspiracy m4c
notes: Treatment = conspiracy m4c (film/conspiracy 70fecfa, music-m4.py): cue mono fold, high-pass 100 Hz, high shelves 6 kHz -6 dB and 11 kHz -8 dB, normalised to -18 LUFS; under speech the cue sits at -29.3 LUFS (m4c's '+9'), 5 dB higher between words; sidechain from the dialogue (10 ms RMS key -44..-38 dBFS, 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release); no breakpoints, swells, dips, guard trim or minimum-gap logic. Program -16 LUFS, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP before AAC (finish-m3.py); AAC 192k on master and phone.

Plan unchanged from s06-m1 (1e38b35): noir (suno-5-noir-a) one uncut segment, cut in at track 84.160 s at scene 0.236 s (5 ms raised-cosine head fade) so bar 23 lands on frame 9 after the takeover (frame 8) and before 'Alright' (0.375); bar 28 on the door shut (frame 576); raised-cosine fade 19.40-19.70; slot slam, REJECTED and the freeze dry.
Start: the cue already enters at 0.236 s, on the takeover frame, before the first word; not moved.
Intro: the used span (bars 23-28) is the cue's body (first 6 s short-term median within 0.6 dB of the span's); no intro levelling.

Highs: spectral check of the used span (100 Hz high-passed): no tonal spike above 12 kHz (largest 7.7 dB over its +-400 Hz median at 14.0 kHz in high-band frames, none in the long-term spectrum; the conspiracy cue's notched 16.8 kHz tone reads 9.0 dB on the same check); no notch.

Effects as m1 (each file gained to -20 LUFS event loudness + gain, hit on its frame); stamp rule: REJECTED stamp 0 -> -2 dB. The door shut (stamp-thump-3 file used as a door thud) is not a stamp cue and stays -6 dB.

guard.note: measured and reported, not enforced (as conspiracy m4)
